name: adk_agent_builder
description: Describe the agent you want and get it built. The builder designs it with you on Google's Agent Development Kit, then generates a complete, production-ready project on nuvel (FastAPI server, plugin chain, guardrails, Dockerfile and tests) and hands it over as a zip.

useCases.title: Build From Scratch
useCases.description: Turn a one-line idea into a complete ADK project you can download and run

useCases.title: Architecture Advice
useCases.description: Choose between a single LlmAgent, a Workflow graph, or a multi-agent team

useCases.title: Production Ready
useCases.description: nuvel's skeleton: cost guard, tracing, guardrails, memory, Docker and Railway config

useCases.title: Tools & Integrations
useCases.description: Function tools, MCP servers, Composio integrations, and Slack, Telegram or Teams gateways

useCases.title: Prompts & Skills
useCases.description: System prompts, SOUL.md identity, and SKILL.md domain knowledge for your agent

useCases.title: ADK Questions
useCases.description: Grounded answers from nuvel's ADK skills and the official ADK docs

samplePrompts: Build me an agent that searches the web and writes a sourced one-page summary.
Build a Slack bot that triages support requests and drafts replies from our help center.
Design a multi-agent pipeline that researches, drafts and reviews a weekly newsletter, then build it.
What's the best architecture for an agent that needs both code execution and web search?
How do I add a human-in-the-loop approval step before a destructive action?
author: Albert Folch
